text:
We create disposable CLI profiles. Only supplied ratings enter Dossier. Hidden ratings score its completed ranking. Invented users began as pipeline checks. Later tests used historical anonymous MovieLens viewers, not people recruited to use Dossier today. The original 31, the next 47 and the next 30 viewers are separate groups. Four rating orders per person are repeated sessions, not extra people. We rank only films they previously rated.

text: In the real-viewer test, public reviews found nearly two more liked films per ten.
textPreview: In the real-viewer test, public reviews found nearly two more liked films per ten.

text:
Easy invented sci-fi persona: 98% after one rating and ten of ten liked suggestions after ten. The larger early invented cohort had 264 profiles, including 240 variations. Hidden preferences used many of the same film properties as Dossier, so a simple cosine matcher also performed almost perfectly. Hard invented test:18 people,288 films; Dossier76.1% versus nearest75.4% after20. Real bundled film test:31 historical viewers,1736 films; after20 Dossier61.1%, publicreviews82.3%,popularity73.6%. Across these tests the people and film details differ, so this is a lesson about test credibility, not a measured model decline.

Sources: reports/presentations/evidence-summary.json; reports/dossier-real-v1-baseline.json; reports/dossier-hard-v1-baseline.html
